Added a `SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` set (`EUR`, `GBP`, `USD`) and a guard at the top of [`formatAmount()`](src/payment-utils.ts:8) that throws `Error: Unsupported currency: <code>` for any other value.

**[`src/payment-utils.test.ts`](src/payment-utils.test.ts)**  
Added two new tests in the `formatAmount` describe block:
- throws on an unknown code (`JPY`)
- throws on an empty string
